definitions.explanation: Quiet, composed, and gentle in speech and movement. Traditionally used to praise women, so in modern usage it can sound old-fashioned or, said of someone acting out of character, faintly teasing.

examples.japanese: おしとやかな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧です⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: She is a graceful person, isn't she.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妹|いもうと}→妹：00573_imouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人前|ひとまえ}→人前：19380_hitomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おしとやか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧。
examples.english: My younger sister behaves demurely in front of others.

examples.japanese: ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧おしとやかな⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When I wear a kimono, I feel a little more demure than usual.

notes:
The polite prefix お attached to ⟦{淑|しと}やか→淑やか：05737_shitoyaka⟧; both forms exist, but おしとやか is the commoner one in speech and is written in kana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- おしとやかな⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: a graceful woman
- おしとやか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧: to behave demurely
- おしとやか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to act like a lady

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上品|じょうひん}→上品：03081_jouhin⟧: refined, elegant — about taste and class, and applies to objects as well as people
- ⟦{控|ひか}えめ→控えめ：17234_hikaeme⟧: modest, reserved — about holding back rather than about grace of manner
- ⟦{大人|おとな}しい→大人しい：02339_otonashii⟧: quiet, well-behaved — neutral about elegance, and freely used of men and children
